# DTT: Defend The Tree

> DTT: Defend The Tree is an indie defense race mobile game by LOEND, a five-person indie game studio in Jeju, Korea. It combines tower defense with time attack: every player gets the same stage, and the fastest clear wins. Early Access on iOS (App Store) since September 2026; Android pre-registration open on Google Play. Free to play with optional in-app purchases.

- Genre: defense race (tower defense × time attack), strategy, indie
- Modes: PvE story mode (chapters of enemy waves, boss at the end of each chapter, playable offline) and PvP ranked play (same stage, compete on clear time, ranking board, no real-time matchmaking)
- Gameplay: throw skill cards at the right moment; build a party of Anima guardians with runes; pick augments and relics mid-run; read boss patterns and counter
- Recommended for: fans of tower defense and survival games, players who want strategy without dodging controls, short sessions and ranking races, cute animal characters
- Languages: English, Korean, Japanese
